title: Pick
description: The `pick` document: what picking one commit onto one branch did.

commit.description: The picked commit, full hex sha.

new_commit.description: The new commit on the target, full hex sha; present only when `outcome` is `picked`.

reason.description: Why; present only when `outcome` is `conflict` or `skipped`.

oneOf.description: The commit was picked onto the target.
The three-way merge conflicts; the target is unchanged.
Refused before any change (root or merge commit, already on the target, dirty checkout).
